findings.title: GroupPermissionsV2.canManage() grants global manage access on VIEW scope
findings.body: In `GroupPermissionsV2.canManage()`, line 70 calls `hasPermission(null, AdminPermissionsSchema.VIEW, AdminPermissionsSchema.MANAGE)`. Passing `AdminPermissionsSchema.VIEW` here means any user granted the `view` scope on the `all-groups` resource will also pass `canManage()` / `requireManage()`. Since `GroupsResource.addTopLevelGroup` checks `auth.groups().requireManage()`, a user with only `view` permission on all groups can create top-level groups or move existing groups to top level. `canManage()` should only check for `AdminPermissionsSchema.MANAGE` (and the Javadoc on `GroupPermissionEvaluator.canManage()` at line 75 should be updated accordingly).

findings.title: getGroupIdsWithViewPermission() uses resource.getId() instead of resource.getName() (and resources lacked type)
findings.body:
In `GroupPermissionsV2.getGroupIdsWithViewPermission()`, `resourceStore.findByType(server, AdminPermissionsSchema.GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE, ...)` iterates over group resources and calls `hasPermission(groupResource.getId(), ...)` and `granted.add(groupResource.getId())`. However:
1. When `AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource` creates a resource for a specific group, it sets the resource's `name` to the `group.getId()` (while `resource.getId()` is an auto-generated resource UUID), and `hasPermission(String groupId, ...)` looks up the resource via `resourceStore.findByName(server, groupId)`. Passing `groupResource.getId()` to `hasPermission` will not find the group resource by name, and adding `groupResource.getId()` to `granted` returns the authorization resource UUID instead of the `GroupModel` ID expected by `session.users().searchForUserStream` / `getUsersCount`.
2. Furthermore, `AdminPermissionsSchema.getOrCreateResource` does not call `resource.setType(resourceType)` when creating a per-entity resource—only the 'all-groups' resource created in `AdminPermissionsSchema.init` has `type = "Groups"`. As a result, `resourceStore.findByType(server, AdminPermissionsSchema.GROUPS_RESOURCE_TYPE, ...)` will only ever find the `Groups` (all-groups) resource and never individual group resources.

findings.title: AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceName() does not handle GROUPS resource type
findings.body: `AdminPermissionsSchema.getResourceName(KeycloakSession, Policy, Resource)` resolves human-readable names for resources in the admin permissions client (currently handling `USERS`), and falls back to `resource.getDisplayName()`. Because `GROUPS` is not handled here and `getOrCreateResource` does not set a displayName on created group resources, `getResourceName` will return `null` (or the raw UUID) for group resources when representations are built.

findings.title: Javadoc for requireManageMembers references canManageMembership instead of canManageMembers
findings.body: On line 133, the Javadoc for `requireManageMembers(GroupModel group)` says `Throws ForbiddenException if {@link #canManageMembership(GroupModel)} returns {@code false}.` It should reference `{@link #canManageMembers(GroupModel)}`.
